main.title: CPU Integration and Verification
main.speaker: A
main.goal: Identify the integrated design and the five parts of this presentation.
main.speech: Good morning. Our project is a sixteen-bit, five-stage CPU with four writable registers. We integrated it on EES-331. We will explain the ISA, design process, complete architecture, functional verification, and performance.
main.cue: 开场直接对应老师要求。版本为CPU v1.6、ISA v1.5、默认AC1。

main.title: Complete ISA Encoding
main.speaker: A
main.goal: Present every opcode and the complete instruction field layout.
main.speech: Every instruction occupies sixteen bits. The fields are a four-bit opcode, two register fields, and an eight-bit immediate or displacement. This table contains the entire encoding, including the two reserved opcodes. AND and OR use two and three; loads and stores use eight and nine. The field roles depend on the instruction. Register zero is an ordinary writable register.
main.cue: 展示完整16项编码，讲分组，不逐格念。Rd字段在CMP/STR等形式中的角色要分清。

main.title: Operands, Immediates and State Updates
main.speaker: A
main.goal: Explain source roles and all architectural write permissions.
main.speech: These rules determine the datapath. Register arithmetic reads both fields, while immediate MOV needs no register source. A store reads its base from Rs and its data from Rd. Constants and absolute jumps use zero extension; memory displacements and conditional branches use sign extension. ADD and SUB update carry and overflow. CMP updates only Z. Other operations preserve those flags.
main.cue: 真实源、写入目标和Z/C/V规则；C为进位或减法无借位。下一页将这些规则连接到设计流程。

main.title: Design Process and Dependencies
main.speaker: A
main.goal: Connect the engineering decisions in their dependency order.
main.speech: We defined instruction behavior and constraints, then resources and interfaces. Memory timing and pipeline boundaries determined the control and hazard rules. Integration followed those contracts. Simulation checked behavior, implementation checked FPGA mapping, and board observations checked selected programs. Development was iterative across Pre2 to Pre5; this diagram shows the dependencies between decisions. B will now present the connected hardware.
main.cue: 先指设计依赖链，再讲课程实际迭代过程；末句交接B。

main.title: Complete CPU Architecture
main.speaker: B
main.goal: Show the full control, datapath, memories and feedback connections.
main.speech: This complete architecture places control above the five datapath stages. It includes mode, decode, stage responsibilities, and cross-stage arbitration. The lower paths carry data and feedback. IM and DM sit outside the core. Local CU names identify implementation responsibilities.
main.cue: 这是完整总图；沿上下层指出CU、DP、外部IM/DM。细节在后续页放大，不逐线念。

main.title: Complete Five-Stage Datapath
main.speaker: B
main.goal: Retain all functional paths and the four existing pipeline boundaries.
main.speech: The full datapath shows PC, RF, extension, forwarding, ALU, branch logic, memory, and writeback. Four boundaries align data, control, and valid tags. The registered IM output supplies the decode data boundary; registered DM output supplies the load return. No additional instruction or memory-data register is cascaded there.
main.cue: 完整图保留前递、Z选择、目标计算和RF/flags回路。强调同步IM/DM输出承担边界。

main.title: Operand and Result Paths
main.speaker: B
main.goal: Trace register, store, branch and writeback paths in the detailed design.
main.speech: Execute first selects the newest available register operands. The ALU input selection then chooses a register or extended immediate. Store data follows its own path beside address calculation. Branch target calculation and Z selection are separate from that address path. At writeback, the result selector chooses an execution result or load data; qualified enables update RF or flags.
main.cue: 放大原完整datapath中ID/EX至WB部分。分开指STR基址与数据、目标地址与Z条件。

main.title: Core Integration and Logical Interfaces
main.speaker: B
main.goal: Connect the complete system diagram to every original execution port.
main.speech: The system connects two synchronous memories, each with two hundred and fifty-six sixteen-bit words. The original twelve execution ports total eighty-seven bits and carry clock, reset, memory traffic, and stop status. The core checks the complete sixteen-bit effective address before indexing memory. Observation ports are additional. Core reset preserves committed data memory.
main.cue: 左完整系统图，右完整原执行接口表。同步读一拍、store只写一次、reset不重载DM。

main.title: EES-331 Board Integration
main.speaker: B
main.goal: Explain the complete clock, reset, VIO and observation connections.
main.speech: The board top adds the clock buffer, synchronized reset release, counters, LEDs, and VIO. M19 is the clock input and L18 is the active-low S1 request. VIO reads a writeback shadow, stop state, and counters; its reset output is a real control input. C will now explain pipeline control.
main.cue: 完整板级图。RF读数是写回影子；VIO reset是控制输入，不能说整个VIO完全只读。交接C。

main.title: Complete Pipeline Control
main.speaker: C
main.goal: Explain global mode, traveling control fields and qualified stage actions.
main.speech: Global mode handles running, draining, and stopping. Cross-stage logic checks dependencies, readiness, and instruction age. Local logic turns traveling control intentions into stage actions. The existing X, M, and W control groups contain eighteen, seven, and five bits. Decode can request a register write, but only an eligible writeback slot produces rf_we. Data and control belong to the same instruction.
main.cue: 指完整CU放大图：FSM与跨级仲裁在上，各级资格在下。CW_X/M/W不是额外寄存器或五个FSM。

main.title: Operating Modes and Event Priority
main.speaker: C
main.goal: Show the complete five-mode transition graph and qualified priority order.
main.speech: RUN permits normal progress, stalls, and redirects. An accepted HALT or instruction fault starts the corresponding drain mode. The stopping token reaches writeback before the core enters HALTED or FAULTED. Reset returns the core to RUN. Arbitration considers instruction age: an older memory fault suppresses a younger execute event while preserving eligible older writeback. The illegal-mode fallback separately enters the fail-safe faulted state.
main.cue: 五状态是整机运行模式，不是IF到WB串行状态。MEM故障优先于年轻EX事件，不能把不可能并发的事件硬画成状态转移。

main.title: Dependencies and Resolution Network
main.speaker: C
main.goal: Show forwarding, bypass, interlock, flag selection and false-source exclusion.
main.speech: Forwarding checks both real sources and selects the nearest eligible producer: M, then W, then the saved operand. An unready load cannot forward its address or permit an older same-register value. An adjacent load dependency holds the front end once. WB-to-ID bypass handles simultaneous RF read and write. CMP-to-JZ selects the newest Z. Source-use masks exclude false dependencies.
main.cue: 完整矩阵包含数据、标志、控制和资源；R0可写，Rd=Rs两路独立检查。Harvard排除IF/MEM争用，顺序流水排除WAR/WAW。

main.title: Load-to-Store Interlock: Eight Cycles
main.speaker: C
main.goal: Explain the real eight-cycle trace and exactly one memory write.
main.speech: This trace loads seven into R zero and stores it through R one. In cycle three, the load executes while the store waits in decode. The front end holds; cycle four contains an execute bubble. In cycle five, writeback forwards the ready load value. The store writes memory in cycle six and keeps its WB tag in seven. HALT completes in eight. Adjacent ADDs use ready M forwarding without this stall. D will explain control flow and verification.
main.cue: 按真实C3保持/C4 bubble/C5 W前递/C6唯一DM写/C7 STR标签/C8HALT讲。初态来自TB预置。交接D。

main.title: CMP, JZ and Wrong-Path Cancellation
main.speaker: D
main.goal: Explain the real nine-cycle branch trace and cancelled store.
main.speech: CMP produces an equality candidate. In cycle four, JZ uses the memory-stage candidate before architectural Z writeback. The accepted redirect cancels the younger wrong-path store. The branch itself continues through memory and writeback. The target HALT finishes in cycle nine. Thus, redirecting early does not create a separate pipeline exit, and the cancelled store never writes memory.
main.cue: C4 M.CMP对X.JZ前递Z，D.STR取消；目标HALT在C9完成。

main.title: HALT, Fault and Precise Completion
main.speaker: D
main.goal: Distinguish a real instruction, a bubble, a held slot and a cancelled slot.
main.speech: A valid instruction may pass through a stage without writing anything. A bubble has no valid instruction; a stall holds an instruction; a flush cancels younger work. In the store-before-HALT example, the older store writes in MEM and continues to WB before HALT stops the processor. Fault arbitration blocks invalid accesses and preserves eligible older work.
main.cue: 用老STR与年轻HALT逐拍表讲年龄；MEM故障压制年轻跳转的例子保持仿真身份。

main.title: Functional Verification and Coverage
main.speaker: D
main.goal: Connect ISA expectations, per-edge assertions and integrated verification layers.
main.speech: Automatic checks compare actual writes, flags, stores, stop state, and cycle events with ISA behavior and explicit expectations. Existing evidence includes module and hazard tests, forty-eight independent cases, and ten reset witnesses. This delivery also includes fresh Vivado runs of five programs and the eleven-case system suite. Each layer provides finite, specific coverage.
main.cue: 分层展示已有回归与本次新运行；21项主机/文档检查不是实板功能测试。

main.title: Actual XSim Waveform and Reproduction
main.speaker: D
main.goal: Show sampled events from the delivered project and its executable entry.
main.speech: This delivered baseline waveform shows qualified events at active clock edges. In cycle nine, a front-end stall coexists with an older store. We check the stall, memory write, redirect, and writeback sequence, plus the final result. The package includes RTL, testbenches, images, project creation, WDB, and VCD. Open the included project or rerun these checks from the course directory.
main.cue: 显示本次baseline真实edge数据，并给出工程相对位置与运行命令；不伪造Vivado界面截图。

main.title: Board Results and Physical S1 Reset
main.speaker: D
main.goal: Present all five archived physical outcomes and the raw reset sequence.
main.speech: All five archived EES-331 programs reached their expected normal stop. We decoded two stable VIO snapshots per program. Checksum ends with R one equal to hexadecimal one two three two after fifty-five cycles. The raw S1 samples show fifty-five cycles before pressing, zero while reset is held, and fifty-five again after release. This physical reset test starts after the CPU has stopped. E will use the recorded counters to explain performance.
main.cue: 完整五程序表、checksum终态、四帧S1和原始hex摘录同在正文。标签注明Decoded archived VIO snapshots。交接E。

main.title: Performance Counters and Cycle Model
main.speaker: E
main.goal: Define the physical counters and the domain of the cycle equation.
main.speech: We measure performance through completed instructions, cycles, load-use stalls, and accepted redirects. For these five normal-HALT programs, total cycles equal N plus four plus S plus twice R. N includes HALT. Four represents pipeline filling and completion; each accepted redirect costs two cycles. CPI divides cycles by N. This formula describes the current fixed-latency AC1 pipeline under these conditions.
main.cue: 先定义N、S、R、C和CPI，再展示数值。不要把公式推广到故障或任意复位epoch。

main.title: Measured Cycles and CPI
main.speaker: E
main.goal: Explain the complete five-program cycle breakdown and avoid workload ranking.
main.speech: The bars separate instructions from overhead. Baseline is ten plus four plus one plus two: seventeen cycles. Loop's four redirects add eight cycles. Checksum is thirty-five plus four plus sixteen: fifty-five. Despite more stalls, checksum's CPI is one point five seven, below baseline's one point seven zero, because more instructions spread the fixed overhead. Different workloads cannot rank CPU designs by total cycles. The counters are physical VIO observations. Time conversion assumes the designed one-hundred-megahertz clock; frequency and wall time were not independently measured.
main.cue: 按堆叠颜色讲N/4/S/2R，重点loop与checksum；总周期不能跨工作量排名。

main.title: FPGA Resources and Routed Timing
main.speaker: E
main.goal: Show all five implementation results with their correct top-level scope.
main.speech: These are complete board-top results, including memories, VIO, and observation logic. All five archived implementations use two BRAM18 blocks and have positive setup and hold slack at the ten-nanosecond constraint. The table reports WNS and WHS, rather than propagation delays. These resource counts should not be compared directly with core-only synthesis figures.
main.cue: 完整资源和setup/hold表回到正文；LUT total含LUTRAM，WNS/WHS单位ns。

main.title: Optimization Experiments and Final Choice
main.speaker: E
main.goal: Account for both completed offline candidates without changing the accepted design.
main.speech: We evaluated two isolated candidates. A forwarding-MUX rewrite kept cycle counts unchanged and did not improve the routed result overall. WB-to-MEM forwarding reduced memory-copy cycles from fifteen to fourteen and checksum from fifty-five to forty-seven, with extra logic. Those are offline comparisons. Default AC1 remains the physically accepted implementation used throughout this presentation.
main.cue: 两项已做候选都纳入正文。WB_MEM不会免除STR基址相关停顿；候选未实板验收。

main.title: Deliverables and Independent Verification
main.speaker: E
main.goal: Close the assignment with the actual runnable files and design document.
main.speech: We delivered the ISA, complete architecture, design process, and functional and performance evidence. The course folder now includes the updated core document, this presentation, the group script, and a runnable Vivado package. The sources and test results identify the accepted AC1 design. Thank you.
main.cue: 收束到老师四项要求与常用目录的真实工程文件。演示可选，不自动连接硬件。

questions: Why do five pipeline stages not mean five global execution states?
RUN can persist while different instructions occupy all five stages. The global modes describe running, draining and stopping. Local actions depend on each slot and cross-stage decisions.
What is the difference between a control intention and an enable?
Decode creates an intention such as reg_write. Validity, fault status, reset and mode qualify it at the action stage. rf_we is the resulting writeback enable.
Why does load-to-store need a stall in default AC1?

Both store operands are prepared in EX. An adjacent load returns data only at the end of MEM. The store waits one cycle, then forwards ready W data into EX. The WB-to-MEM candidate uses a different contract.
Why does output reg not necessarily imply flip-flops?

A fully assigned combinational always block describes combinational logic. The Verilog variable type permits procedural assignment. State requires clocked storage or incomplete combinational assignment.
What do carry and overflow mean?
For ADD, C is the unsigned carry out. For SUB, C means no borrow. V detects signed overflow. ADD and SUB update C/V, CMP updates Z, and memory-address arithmetic preserves architectural flags.
Where do LDR, STR and CMP calculate their results?
LDR and STR use the ALU for base plus signed displacement, preserving flags. CMP uses the independent equality path on forwarded operands and writes Z in WB.
Why does CMP-to-JZ need no register data stall?
JZ selects the newest eligible CMP Z candidate from M, then W, then saved Z. CMP still updates architectural Z at WB. The branch uses the candidate as a condition.
How does synchronous memory avoid adding a sixth stage?

The registered IM output is the ID instruction data boundary. The registered DM output supplies the WB load value. The existing tag registers align with those outputs. No extra IR or MDR is cascaded there.
How independent is the reference model?

It implements ISA effects separately from pipeline control and is cross-checked against explicit boundary vectors. Timing assertions check implementation-specific events separately. Shared specification errors remain possible, so finite passing tests are not a full proof.
What exactly did the board verify?

Five normal-HALT programs, each with two stable VIO snapshots, plus physical S1 reset/restart after stopping. RF observations are writeback shadows. Fault paths and internal cycle traces retain their simulation evidence.
Why can a longer program have a lower CPI?
Fixed filling overhead is amortized across more completed instructions, and instruction mixes incur different stalls and redirects. Compare the work and overhead, not total cycles alone.
Is the CPU execution time directly measured?
Cycle counters are physically observed. Converting them to nanoseconds assumes the designed 100 MHz clock. Independent frequency, wall-time and power measurements were not performed.
